# [BUG] e2e-playwright.yml has never passed: workflow never starts the stack

## Bug
`.github/workflows/e2e-playwright.yml` ("Playwright E2E Nightly & Manual Tests") has failed on all 32 runs recorded so far (`gh api /repos/pehlivanu/filmpire-microservices/actions/workflows/e2e-playwright.yml/runs`, run numbers 1-32, every `conclusion` is `failure`). Confirmed live on run 33950791021 (2026-09-05): the job installs frontend and Playwright dependencies, then the "Execute Playwright E2E Test Suite" step fails within 30 seconds, every time.

## Root Cause
The workflow never starts the backend stack or the frontend dev server before running `npm test`. `e2e/playwright.config.js` points `baseURL` at `http://localhost:3000` (or `FRONTEND_URL`) and the suite's `BACKEND_API_URL` defaults to `http://localhost:8080`; the job never runs `infrastructure/scripts/start-infrastructure.sh` or `frontend/lmdb`'s dev server, so every request the suite makes has nothing to connect to.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Major
**Priority (business urgency):** P2

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `.github/workflows/e2e-playwright.yml` starts the backend stack and the frontend dev server before `npm test`, and a manual or scheduled run completes with `conclusion: success`
- [ ] The green run's job log shows the suite's three spec files (`user-journeys.spec.js`, `cache-metrics.spec.js`, `auth-flow.spec.js`) executing real assertions, not connection failures

## Notes
Found auditing story #95 / task #38 (#279). #38's and #95's acceptance criteria describing the suite's scenarios and CI wiring are accurate about what exists in `e2e/`, but none of it has been confirmed passing end-to-end — this bug is why.
